_about: A model of a Fabric environment. libraries.public lists packages from public sources such as PyPI, libraries.custom lists files you upload, and resources lists small files notebooks read. publish_mode is Quick or Full; published says whether the latest changes are published. workspace_default_environment names the environment the workspace uses by default.
needs: Every notebook in the workspace uses this environment without anyone attaching it.
Notebooks import great-expectations from PyPI and the team's own package, contoso_rules-1.2.0-py3-none-any.whl.
Notebooks read a small lookup file, country_codes.csv.
Production jobs need a stable, reproducible set of libraries.
